note: Task decomposition of docs/implementation-plan.md. Each task has an evidence-based acceptance. 'evidence' field lists the concrete proof stored under the task's evidence/ folder. env=live means it requires the user's real Teams tenant/phone and cannot be produced headlessly by the agent; env=local means fully verifiable here.

tasks.title: Node + TypeScript project scaffold with build/typecheck/test harness
tasks.spec: Initialize an independent TeamBot Node/TypeScript project (package.json, tsconfig, npm scripts: build, typecheck, test). Add a test runner (node --test or vitest) and a trivial passing test to prove the harness runs.
tasks.acceptance: npm run typecheck passes with 0 errors; npm test runs and reports at least 1 passing test; npm run build produces output.

tasks.title: Pin & generate Codex app-server protocol schema; verify method/event names
tasks.spec: Using codex-cli 0.156.1, generate the app-server JSON/TS schema. Commit the generated artifact. Add a test asserting the method names the architecture depends on (initialize, thread/start, thread/resume, turn/start, turn/steer, turn/interrupt) and key event names exist in the generated schema.
tasks.acceptance: Generated schema file committed; test asserts each required method/event name is present (or documents the real name if different, updating docs).

tasks.title: SQLite storage layer (inbox, outbox, jobs, approvals) with migrations
tasks.spec: Implement a storage module over SQLite with schema/migrations for inbox, outbox, jobs, approvals, events, pairings. Transactional writes.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests cover create/read/update for each table and a transactional multi-write; tests pass.

tasks.title: Inbox dedup and pairing baseline
tasks.spec: Dedup incoming messages by (tenant/account, chatId, messageId); establish baseline at first pairing so history is not executed; edited old messages do not trigger new jobs.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: same message read twice -> dispatched once; message before baseline -> ignored; edited old message -> no new job.

tasks.title: !tb command parser and ID naming (T/A/Q)
tasks.spec: Fixed parser for !tb commands (help, projects, run, status, continue, steer, stop, approve, deny, answer, result). Case-insensitive prefix normalization. ID naming per architecture (T=job, A=approval, Q=question).
tasks.acceptance: Parser unit tests cover every command, malformed input, and that a [TB ...] report line is NOT parsed as a command.

tasks.title: Router: identity check, allowlist, per-conversation binding, permission table
tasks.spec: Route only verified !tb messages. Enforce group member allowlist, per-conversation binding, and the §5 permission table (start/query/continue-stop/approve-answer/admin).
tasks.acceptance: Tests from the plan's verification table: group general chat & unauthorized member -> no dispatch; query self-chat jobId from group -> no private content; same display name different ID -> no permission; unregistered project -> no Codex start.

tasks.title: Codex app-server stdio adapter (initialize/thread/turn/steer/interrupt)
tasks.spec: Client that spawns codex app-server over stdio, performs initialize/initialized handshake, thread/start & thread/resume, turn/start, reads item/turn events, turn/steer with expectedTurnId, turn/interrupt, and answers approval/input requests.
tasks.acceptance: Integration test performs a real handshake against codex-cli 0.156.1 in an isolated temp dir and observes at least one turn lifecycle; interrupt is honored. (Falls back to documented skip with reason if codex not available at runtime.)

tasks.title: Supervisor: job state machine, single active turn, queue, project lock
tasks.spec: Job lifecycle (queued->starting->running->completed/failed, waiting_input/waiting_approval, stopping->cancelled, interrupted/unknown). One active turn per thread. Global single-job MVP with explicit queueing; project lock scaffold.
tasks.acceptance: State-machine tests cover all transitions and illegal transitions; concurrent submissions from self-chat and group -> correct queue order, results routed to source.

tasks.title: Progress coalescing and transactional outbox
tasks.spec: Coalesce progress events (<=1 per 30s guidance), segment long messages with jobId/seq/part, transactional outbox with 'send status unknown' retention; no exactly-once claim.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: bursty events coalesced; long message segmented; send-uncertain kept in outbox for reconciliation.

tasks.title: Playwright Teams adapter against a local fixture page
tasks.spec: Playwright adapter that reads new messages, confirms conversation identity, serializes sends and reconciles results — driven against a local HTML fixture emulating the Teams DOM (stable chat/message/sender IDs).
tasks.acceptance: Playwright test against the fixture: reads a new message, extracts (chatId, messageId, senderId), sends a reply, reconciles it. Serialized single-writer verified.

tasks.title: Electron Browser Host (isolated Teams WebContentsView)
tasks.spec: Port the isolated WebContentsView + persistent partition + login popup + view ownership design from ../codex-chatgpt-web (preserve MIT notices). No preload/Node integration for the remote page. Loopback-only control endpoint.
tasks.acceptance: Launcher builds; a smoke test starts the shell, loads the fixture/login URL in the isolated view, and confirms no Node integration is exposed to the page.

tasks.title: Phase 1 end-to-end: help/projects/run/status/result with fixtures
tasks.spec: Wire inbox+router+adapter+store+outbox with mock Teams fixture and mock/real Codex. Implement help, projects, run, status, result. Single running job.
tasks.acceptance: Integration test: one fixture phone message creates exactly one job; Codex runs in the registered project; status queryable; completion/failure returned to the source conversation.

tasks.title: Phase 2 interactive control: continue/steer/stop/approve/deny/answer
tasks.spec: Add continue, steer, stop, approve, deny, answer with idempotent inbox, duplicate/expired approval handling, stop-vs-actually-stopped distinction, approval codes bound per §5.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: mid-run query/steer/answer; wrong-source/expired approval rejected without affecting the turn; stopping vs cancelled distinguished; dangerous-op approval routed to self-chat.

tasks.title: Phase 3 restart/reconnect/checkpoint recovery
tasks.spec: Teams re-login, browser reload, checkpoint recovery; outbox reconciliation, send-status-unknown, process-loss, approval-wait recovery; offline recovery notice (arch §7).
tasks.acceptance: Tests: restart does not re-run history nor misroute results; unrecoverable jobs clearly marked; Teams offline but job done -> result held in outbox, reconciled on recovery.

tasks.title: Data retention/deletion and secret hygiene (arch §8)
tasks.spec: Implement TTL-based retention for audit/approval/cache/jobs, batch delete per conversation/job, and ensure logs/diagnostics exclude token/cookie/full env.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: expired records purged per TTL; batch delete removes a job's approvals/events/cache; log redaction verified.

tasks.title: Desktop console: project registration, pairing, status page, tray, explicit quit
tasks.spec: Desktop UI to register project aliases (normalized paths), pair conversations, member allowlist, per-job initiator, status page, tray minimize, explicit quit coordinating running jobs.
tasks.acceptance: UI build passes; component/logic tests for project registration path normalization and pairing baseline; manual-run instructions documented.

tasks.title: Windows install package, settings docs, redacted diagnostics export
tasks.spec: Produce a Windows installer/package, settings documentation, and a redacted diagnostics export.
tasks.acceptance: Packaging script runs and produces an artifact; diagnostics export verified free of secrets.

tasks.title: Phase 0 LIVE: real tenant login, stable IDs, dual-surface, phone push (user-run)
tasks.spec: Provide a guided harness + checklist for the user to run against their real Teams tenant: verify login/conditional access, stable chat/message/sender IDs, self-chat + one group dual-surface, background updates, reply targeting, same-account phone push behavior. Record go/no-go with fallback per plan.
tasks.acceptance: User executes the harness and records results in evidence/results.md (go/no-go + which capabilities verified/blocked). Agent cannot self-verify (requires live tenant + phone; real Teams sends restricted per AGENTS.md).

tasks.title: Connect Playwright to the app-owned Teams surface over CDP
tasks.spec: Production wiring (architecture §9): the Electron host owns the isolated Teams WebContentsView and exposes a loopback-only remote-debugging endpoint; PlaywrightTeamsAdapter attaches via chromium.connectOverCDP to that existing surface instead of launching its own browser, then drives it with the teams selector profile.
tasks.acceptance: Integration test: an Electron host loads the teams-v2 fixture in an isolated WebContentsView with a loopback debugging port; the adapter connectOverCDP attaches, reads chatId + messages, sends+reconciles. Skips if electron/browser unavailable.

tasks.title: Default AgentHub workspace for !tb (D:\AgentHub)
tasks.spec: Establish a default personal-assistant workspace at D:\AgentHub and register it as the default project so !tb has a default startup folder. Ensure the folder exists; register a normalized absolute cwd.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: default workspace constant points to an absolute D:\AgentHub; registerDefaults registers it in the ProjectRegistry; ensureWorkspace creates the folder; folder exists on disk.

tasks.title: Security defaults: switchable read-only posture, path allow-list, always-approve, redaction
tasks.spec: Roadmap A from product-brainstorm. Default execution posture read-only; !tb unlock <duration> switches to workspace-write until expiry; !tb lock relocks; !tb kill hard-stops. Path allow-list confines writes to AgentHub (canonicalized; reject .., UNC, symlink escape, absolute-outside). always-approve classifier flags destructive/network/secret/elevation ops. Redact outbound Teams messages. Wire posture + commands into the resident runner.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests: SecurityPolicy default read-only, unlock opens workspace-write until expiry then reverts, lock relocks; isPathAllowed confines to root; isAlwaysApprove flags destructive/network/secret/elevation; outbound redaction scrubs tokens. Parser recognizes unlock/lock/kill. Full suite green.

tasks.title: Result reducer: turn fold -> final answer + change list (roadmap B)
tasks.spec: Reduce a turn's events into one authoritative result: extract final_answer agent text (ignore commentary/deltas), collect files changed (from turn/diff/updated + fileChange items) and commands run (from commandExecution items with exit codes). Idempotent outbox keyed by (turnId, kind) with edit-upsert semantics.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests: reducer picks final_answer over commentary; aggregates file changes and commands; produces a two-tier summary; outbox (turnId,kind) uniqueness prevents duplicate result rows.

tasks.title: Live status model + coalescer wiring (roadmap C)
tasks.spec: Build a per-turn live status model fed by item/plan/delta (todo), item/started (current step), commandExecution/outputDelta (tail), tokenUsage (footer); coalesce to <=1 update/interval and only when dirty; heartbeat for idle detection; a status snapshot readable without the model.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests: bursty deltas coalesce to one dirty-gated update; plan/step/tail/token reflected in snapshot; heartbeat flags idle; status snapshot readable synchronously.

tasks.title: Approval registry: code<->requestId, timeouts, steer (roadmap D)
tasks.spec: Registry binding Teams approval code <-> Codex server-request id; supports multiple pending, expiry (timeout -> pause/auto-decline, never auto-approve), requestUserInput answers, and steer-vs-new-turn routing. Distinguish command/file/permissions request kinds and their response shapes.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests: bind+resolve by code; multiple pending distinct codes; expiry auto-declines; unknown/duplicate rejected; requestUserInput answered by id; decision shapes correct per kind.

tasks.title: Event-driven Teams inbox via MutationObserver (roadmap E)
tasks.spec: Replace read-polling with a MutationObserver in the Teams page that pushes new-message events to the host (exposeBinding/CDP), with a monotonic cursor and dedupe; keep a slow poll as a safety net.
tasks.acceptance: Integration test (real browser/electron): injecting a new message node triggers a pushed event with the new message id; dedupe prevents reprocessing; falls back to poll if binding unavailable.

tasks.title: Continuity & recovery via thread/resume (roadmap F)
tasks.spec: Persist the resident threadId; on boot call thread/resume to restore context; replay unresolved approvals/outbox; mark in-flight jobs interrupted and re-post status.
tasks.acceptance: Unit/integration tests: threadId persisted+reloaded; resume path invoked; unresolved outbox/approvals replayed; in-flight jobs marked interrupted (not re-run).

tasks.title: Optional multi-task via additional threads + git worktrees (roadmap G)
tasks.spec: Allow opt-in parallel tasks by binding additional Codex threads to isolated git worktrees; project lock ensures same project never runs twice concurrently. Default remains single resident thread.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests: worktree allocator assigns isolated dirs; scheduler runs different projects in parallel while serializing same-project; default single-thread unchanged.

tasks.title: R0a: CDP editMessage feasibility spike
tasks.spec: In the real tenant over CDP, programmatically edit a message you just sent (by data-mid) and read it back to confirm the content changed. Verify whether data-mid stays stable after an edit (if not, the heartbeat locator key drifts).
tasks.acceptance: Live evidence: before/after DOM content of the same data-mid; a note on data-mid stability. This gates H.

tasks.title: R0b: notification economics + GO/PIVOT decision
tasks.spec: Measure on a real phone: (1) does a NEW message push; (2) does editing the same message 3x push again; (3) does high-frequency editing within 60s accumulate into a push or trigger throttling. Decide GO (edit does not push) vs PIVOT (edit pushes).
tasks.acceptance: Live observation log; GO/PIVOT conclusion written back into PRD §0.

tasks.title: Governance: §4 reconciliation + traceability table
tasks.spec: Build a PRD↔architecture↔code(file:line)↔test traceability table. Any P0 requirement with an empty cell may not be marked ✅. Correct fake ✅ (stop/kill/steer etc.) across tasks/README and PRD §4.
tasks.acceptance: traceability table committed; tasks/README statuses corrected to match code reality; a test or check that flags a ✅ without evidence.

tasks.title: R9: append-only audit schema
tasks.spec: Add an append-only audit table (no UPDATE/DELETE) recording {ts, senderId, conversation, redacted command, decision deny/allow/whitelist-add, matched rule}. Write on every deny/allow/whitelist path.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests: each decision path writes an audit row; UPDATE/DELETE on the table is rejected; redaction applied.

tasks.title: R7a: path wall attribution + sandbox bypass tests
tasks.spec: Reframe the path wall as Codex sandbox writableRoots (TeamBot does not re-implement it). Add bypass tests against the sandbox's real write behavior: .. / absolute-outside / UNC / junction / %VAR%; CI builds a junction pointing to C:\ and asserts writes are denied.
tasks.acceptance: Bypass test suite runs against actual sandbox write behavior; each bypass is denied; evidence captured. §8/§9 'outside-AgentHub = 0' only claimed after this.

tasks.title: R7b: blacklist reframed as escalate-to-ask + adversarial tests
tasks.spec: Change blacklist from 'claims to block' to 'match → escalate to must-ask/isolate'. Fill missing patterns (diskpart, Set-ExecutionPolicy, takeown, fsutil, wmic, certutil -decode). Add positive + adversarial negatives per class (case, spaces, quote-splicing, PS aliases, -EncodedCommand, backticks).
tasks.acceptance: Per-class tests pass; wording in §9 threat table corrected (no 'reliable block' claim).

tasks.title: R7c: read/write asymmetry + read-only reference allow-list (Q5)
tasks.spec: Writes limited to AgentHub; reads default to AgentHub plus a configurable read-only reference allow-list. Secret paths hard-denied even if registered (blacklist beats allow-list); realpath-resolved; desktop-set + restart only.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: read allowed in listed dir; write to listed dir denied; secret path denied even when registered; symlink escape denied.

tasks.title: R7d: per-project whitelist store + decision-order tests
tasks.spec: Per-project (keyed by projectId, even if single-valued) whitelist schema + store CRUD. Decision-order unit tests: path-out-of-bounds is denied even if the command is whitelisted (①② before ③).
tasks.acceptance: CRUD tests + order tests (hardwall beats whitelist) pass.

tasks.title: R7e: list commands (ok 永遠 / !tb 名單 / remove / TTL)
tasks.spec: ok 永遠 writes a precise pattern (no wildcard npm run) with echo of the pattern added; per-entry TTL that actively asks before expiring; !tb 名單 to read, !tb 名單 移除 <n> to remove.
tasks.acceptance: Loop test: add → match runs directly → remove → back to asking. Echo + TTL behavior tested.

tasks.title: R8a: emergency stop wiring (stop / kill)
tasks.spec: Wire stop (graceful, turn/interrupt) and kill (hard) into the command layer (coordinator, currently Phase 2). After stop/kill the status card no longer shows ⏳. Stop bypasses push throttle.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: stop drains current step, kill interrupts immediately, status card cleared; live smoke.

tasks.title: R8b: steer wiring + add-vs-new disambiguation
tasks.spec: Mid-turn plain text → turn/steer folds into current turn; attachments queue as next turn; ambiguous → ask 併/新. steer text is never treated as an approval.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: steer folds in; disambiguation routes correctly; steer != approval.

tasks.title: R8c: queue visibility + cancel
tasks.spec: Second task while one runs → queued with position reported; !tb 取消 <n> removes one queued item; !tb 取消 全部 / 清空 clears all queued without touching the running one.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: position reported; single/all cancel; running job unaffected.

tasks.title: Disconnect recovery hardening
tasks.spec: On disconnect fall back to read-only + stop accepting jobs; ?/status returns 'remote-control link broken' when the runner is offline (recovery.ts already has in-flight→unknown, outbox replay, offline-gap notice).
tasks.acceptance: Tests: offline downgrade to read-only; offline status pull returns link-broken.

tasks.title: H1: transport.editMessage() + CDP in-place edit
tasks.spec: Add transport.editMessage() interface and CDP in-place edit implementation (per R0a spike). Depends on task028/029 GO.
tasks.acceptance: Live evidence: a message edited in place and read back.

tasks.title: H2: in-place status card + Codex-event-driven heartbeat (3-state)
tasks.spec: One message morphs (⏳ → doing → conclusion). Heartbeat driven by Codex app-server events, not setInterval; distinguishes progressing / idle / channel-dead. Stuck warning N default 3 min, configurable.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: three-state transitions; stuck-warning fake-clock test.

tasks.title: H3: push budget (debounce/chunk/retry_after)
tasks.spec: Land the push budget: debounce 900ms, chunk 3500, retry_after backoff. Every row of §5 has a corresponding acceptance method.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: throttle interval respected; chunking; retry_after backoff.

tasks.title: R1: bare ok bound to versioned pending queue
tasks.spec: Approval target decided by TeamBot's versioned pending queue; a new pending bumps the version and invalidates a prior bare ok (degrades to a report). Reference carries data only.
tasks.acceptance: Race tests: delayed ok hits old vs new pending; invalidation on state change.

tasks.title: R2: self-chat prefix + reversed escape
tasks.spec: Self-chat default = notes (not sent); explicit marker to send (reversed from '.' escape). First-use opt-in.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: marked vs unmarked routing; opt-in gate.

tasks.title: R5: !tb 交接 (handoff)
tasks.spec: Print thread id + cwd + files changed this turn so you can resume on the desktop.
tasks.acceptance: Test: output matches expected fields.

tasks.title: R6: !tb login/logout + no-turn-when-unauthed
tasks.spec: Codex device login/logout; when not logged in do not start a turn and do not fail silently — say 'Codex not logged in' and offer login.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: unauthed turn intercepted with a clear message.

tasks.title: R3: voice STT spike + echo-confirm
tasks.spec: Spike: can CDP obtain the audio blob / transcript from a Teams voice message. Transcript is echoed for confirmation before entering the parser; destructive wording forces confirmation. If spike fails, drop to P2.
tasks.acceptance: Spike evidence: whether audio/transcript is obtainable; echo-confirm design note.

tasks.title: R4: attachments in/out + artifact auto-return
tasks.spec: Inbound attachments land in .teambot/inbox marked data-only (never parsed as commands); files under turns/out are auto-returned as Teams attachments.
tasks.acceptance: Tests: inbound marked data-only; outbound artifact returned.

tasks.title: §9 metrics instrumentation + benchmark tasks
tasks.spec: Wire a measurement pipeline for each metric (input chars via parser, approvals via audit log, heartbeat interval via status-model, outside-AgentHub via sandbox bypass). Define 3–5 representative benchmark tasks as the denominator.
tasks.acceptance: Metrics emitted and asserted for the benchmark set; unmeasurable metrics documented as goals.

tasks.title: P2: group scenario
tasks.spec: Deferred. When enabled: prefix required, approval codes via crypto.randomBytes, codes not exposed (route to DM), summary-only replies. architecture §5/§9 group sections marked deferred.
tasks.acceptance: Deferred — no acceptance until scheduled.

tasks.title: P2: I multi-session (use latest / sessions / new)
tasks.spec: Deferred. Multiple logical sessions per conversation; switch existing Codex threads.
tasks.acceptance: Deferred — no acceptance until scheduled.

tasks.title: P2: K history import
tasks.spec: Deferred. Import Codex history by cwd; bind an existing thread.
tasks.acceptance: Deferred — no acceptance until scheduled.

tasks.title: P2: N ACL roles + audit_log
tasks.spec: Deferred. allowed/admin/user roles (audit foundation from task031).
tasks.acceptance: Deferred — no acceptance until scheduled.

tasks.title: P2: O config-driven settings
tasks.spec: Deferred. sandbox/approval/writable dirs/model defaults via config file.
tasks.acceptance: Deferred — no acceptance until scheduled.
